adw_patterns.name: Single-Step Software Factory (SSSF)
adw_patterns.description: Deterministic step execution pattern where an agent receives a strictly typed context capsule and produces an audited artifact.
adw_patterns.jit_capsule_strategy: Inject only target schema, input artifact, and specific operating level boundaries.

adw_patterns.name: Adversarial Review Loop
adw_patterns.description: Two-agent pattern where a generator agent's output is subjected to countertests and false-proof defenses by cae-adversarial-reviewer.
adw_patterns.jit_capsule_strategy: Inject generated artifact, countertest rules, and constitutional boundary checks.
